name: Greater Cryostasis · Arcane
primary:
A zone at the aim point with a 5.65-block radius for 21 s. Every second, on everyone inside, including you (damage and control only hit enemies):
• Damage 3 ❤ arcane
• Cold 144: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Heals 3.5 ❤
• Regeneration: +1 ❤ every 2 s for 12 s
• Growth: up to 10 nearby blocks — crops +2 stages, dirt turns to grass, roots grow upward
• Stone skin (Resistance II) for 6 s
• Arcane instability: −0.75 ❤ every 2 s for 9 s
self_description:
